response.answer: IMPORTANT NOTES ON MODEL YEAR / VERSIONING: The Jones Rally Cat was first introduced for the 2025 season (Northern Hemisphere winter 2024/25). The "2027" model year corresponds to the Southern Hemisphere season (2026 Australian/NZ winter) and the upcoming Northern Hemisphere 2026/27 season. The official Jones site currently lists the board under "2026" product URLs. The 2027 model year includes expanded size options (161, 166W, 170W added) compared to earlier model years. Some third-party retailers describe the board shape differently (see disagreements below). 1. Brand: Jones Snowboards [1] 2. Model name: Rally Cat [1] 3. Model year (merchant listing): 2027 [MERCHANT] 4. Manufacturer parent company: Nidecker Group (NDK Group) — which also includes Nidecker, Flow, YES., and Now brands [2] 5. Founder: Jeremy Jones, legendary big mountain snowboarder [3] 6. Company founded: 2009 in Truckee, California (per official Jones "Our Story" page) [3] 7. DISAGREEMENT — Company founding year: Wikipedia states Jones Snowboards was founded in 2010 [2]; Whitelines also says 2010 [4]; the official Jones "Our Story" page says 2009 [3]. The first product lineup debuted in 2010 [5]. Comment: The brand was likely conceived/incorporated in 2009 with first products shipping in 2010. 8. Company headquarters: Truckee, California, USA [3] 9. North American office address: Jones - Nidecker US Inc, 11253 Brockway Rd Suite E202, CA, Truckee, United States [6] 10. Manufacturing location: Dubai, UAE — at the Solico Winter Sports (SWS) factory [7][8] 11. Manufacturing facility powered by: 100% solar power since 2020 [2] 12. Pro model rider association: Inaki Odriozola (listed as "board of choice for" on official site) [6] 13. Sustainability certifications: 1% For The Planet member [4] 14. Rally Cat first introduced: 2025 season (2024/25 Northern Hemisphere winter) [9] 15. Product type: Snowboard [1] 16. Gender: Men's [MERCHANT] 17. Price USD (manufacturer direct): $479.95 [6] 18. Price AUD (merchant listing): $849.99 [MERCHANT] 19. Status (merchant): Preorder [MERCHANT] 20. Estimated availability (merchant): June 8, 2026 [MERCHANT] 21. Australian delivery estimate (Balmoral Boards): Early June 2026 [10] 22. Discounted price (2025 model via Sun & Ski Sports / The Good Ride affiliate): $383.93 [11] 23. Lowest priced Jones board: The Rally Cat is the lowest-priced board in the Jones lineup at $479.95 [9] 24. Price comparison (Board of the World): $84.05 less than the average snowboard price of $468.01 reviewed [9] SELLERS / AVAILABILITY: 25. Available from: Jones Snowboards direct (jonessnowboards.com) — sold out all sizes for current 2026 model year [6] 26. Available from: evo (evo.com) — 2026 model listed [12] 27. Available from: Auski Australia (auski.com.au) — 2027 preorder [19] 35. Available from: Snowboards.eu (European Jones specialist) [20] 36. Warranty: 2+1 year warranty (2 years standard, +1 year on registration) [21] 37. Warranty registration: Must be registered at Jones to unlock the third year [21] 38. Warranty applies only to: Products purchased from Jones Authorized Dealers, non-transferable, original buyer only [21] 39. Returns (Jones direct): New, unused items within 30 days for refund; buyer covers return shipping [6] 40. Warranty service experience (forum): Mixed reviews — some users report slow warranty communication from Jones US, but Australian warranty service has been positive [22] 41. Board category: All Mountain [MERCHANT] 42. All mountain rating: 10/10 [MERCHANT][6] 43. Powder rating: 7/10 [MERCHANT][6] 44. Freestyle/Park rating (merchant): 8/10 [MERCHANT] 45. DISAGREEMENT — Freestyle/Park rating (Jones official 2026 site): 9/10 [6]. Comment: The official Jones site for the current 2026 model shows 9/10, while the merchant listing for the 2027 model shows 8/10. This may reflect a model year change or merchant error. 46. Terrain suitability: All Mountain, Casual Cruising, Freestyle, Park [MERCHANT] 47. Rider level: Beginner-Intermediate [MERCHANT] 48. Riding level displayed on Jones site: Beginner to Intermediate (progress rating 2 out of 5) [6] 49. Shape: Directional Twin [MERCHANT][6] 50. DISAGREEMENT — Shape description (Ballistyx): Ballistyx describes the 2027 Rally Cat as a "True Twin" with symmetrical shape [17]. Comment: Jones official, the merchant listing, and most other retailers describe it as "Directional Twin." Ballistyx appears to be using their own interpretation. The board has 0mm taper and symmetrical tip/tail widths but a 20mm stance setback, making "directional twin" the correct classification per the manufacturer. 51. Camber type: True Camber (Jones True Camber) [MERCHANT][6] 52. Camber description: Full camber providing highest levels of edge response, pop, and grip [6] 53. Camber observation (The Good Ride review): Camber runs to just before the nose/tail with a little early rise before the spoon nose and tail; not as high as the Aviator 2.0 [23] 54. 3D contour base: Low 3D Contour Base — 2mm spoon bevel in nose and 0 to 2mm in tail, starting just before contact points [MERCHANT][12] 55. Profile: True Camber with Low 3D Contour Base [6] 56. Taper: 0mm (no taper) [MERCHANT][6] 57. Setback: 20mm (2cm stance setback across all sizes) [MERCHANT][6] 58. Sidecut type: Progressive Sidecut — radius incrementally increased at far ends as edge reaches contact point [12] 59. Flex rating (merchant/manufacturer): 4/10 (1=soft, 10=stiff) [MERCHANT][16] 60. Flex personality (Jones official): Soft & playful, 2/5 [6] 61. DISAGREEMENT — Flex rating (Ballistyx 2027 description): 6/10 [17]. Comment: Ballistyx's 2027 product description lists the flex as 6/10. Jones official and all other retailers consistently state 4/10. This is most likely an error in Ballistyx's listing. 62. Flex observed (Board of the World): 3.5/5 — "more flexible than anything I've ridden from Jones" [9] 63. Flex observed (Board of the World detail): Nose/tail about 4.5/10, center about 3/10, overall feels like 3/10 [24] 64. Flex pattern (The Good Ride): Medium flex in nose/tail, pretty soft flex between the feet [23] 65. Flex technology: Forever Flex — overbuilt then broken in at factory to mimic 20 days ridden [MERCHANT][12] 66. Flex direction: Flex direction not specified as directional flex by manufacturer — biax fiberglass provides symmetrical flex pattern [6] 67. Core material: Master Core — dual density wood core, 1:1 Poplar to Paulownia ratio in alternating stringers [MERCHANT][6] 68. Core description: Responsibly harvested Paulownia and Poplar; Paulownia reduces weight while Poplar adds durability [6] 69. Fiberglass: Biaxial Fiberglass — dual-layer, dual-directional construction [MERCHANT][6] 70. Fiberglass description: Delivers a forgiving yet snappy board feel with mid-soft torsional flex and quick energy transfer [6] 71. Resin: Bio Resin (plant-based) — 27% plant-based carbon, reduces CO₂ emissions by 33% vs. conventional epoxy [MERCHANT][6][12] 72. Resin trade name: Super Sap Bio-Resin — sourced from co-products/waste products of plant-based industrial processes [12] 73. Sidewall material: Recycled ABS with rounded finish [MERCHANT][6] 74. Sidewall construction: Rounded finish engineered to deflect impact, preventing topsheet chipping and cracks [6] 75. Edge material: Recycled German steel [MERCHANT][6] 76. Edge technology: Traction Tech — strategically placed contact points along running length for enhanced edge grip (described as "Medium Traction Tech") [MERCHANT][12] 77. Base material: Sintered 8000 — Ultra High Molecular Weight Polyethylene (UHMW-PE) and carbon [MERCHANT][12] 78. Base description: Ultra-fast, highly wax absorbent, easy to repair, one of the most durable base materials in the industry [6] 79. Base — same as high-end models: Uses the same Sintered 8000 base as Jones' high-performance Airheart [25] 80. Topsheet: Premium Topsheet — durable and scratch resistant [MERCHANT][6] 81. Factory wax: WEND Natural Wax — ready to ride out of the shop [MERCHANT][6] 82. Factory tuning: Detuned in tip and tail, ready to ride [MERCHANT][6] 83. Mounting pattern: 2x4 Inserts (Standard Pack) [MERCHANT][6] 84. Base color options: Two or more base color options to minimize p-tex waste; order may be filled with either color [15] 85. Available lengths (2027 model, official Jones): 151, 154, 155W, 156, 158, 159W, 161, 162W, 166W, 170W [6] 86. Available lengths (merchant listing 2027): 151cm, 154cm, 156cm, 158cm, 155cm Wide, 159cm Wide, 162cm Wide [MERCHANT]. Comment: Merchant listing appears to show 2025/26 size run; the official Jones 2026 site now shows 161, 166W, 170W as additional new sizes. 87. Width options: Standard and Wide [MERCHANT][6] 88. Board weight 151cm: 2.4kg / 5.4lbs [6] 89. Board weight 154cm: 2.5kg / 5.6lbs [6] 90. Board weight 155W: 2.7kg / 6.0lbs [6] 91. Board weight 156cm: 2.7kg / 5.8lbs [6] 92. Board weight 158cm: 2.8kg / 6.1lbs [6] 93. Board weight 159W: 2.8kg / 6.2lbs [6] 94. Board weight 161cm: 2.8kg / 6.3lbs [6] 95. Board weight 162W: 2.9kg / 6.5lbs [6] 96. Comment: Minor discrepancy likely due to rounding — official rounds to nearest cm. 99. Effective edge 156cm: 1150mm (official Jones) [6]; merchant listing shows 1154mm [MERCHANT]. Comment: Same rounding difference. 100. Waist width 151cm: 247mm [MERCHANT][6] 101. Waist width 156cm: 252mm [MERCHANT][6] 102. Waist width 161cm: 257mm [6] 103. Waist width 166W: 267mm [6] 104. Waist width 170W: 269mm [6] 105. Tip/tail width: Equal across all sizes (e.g., 151cm: 288mm nose = 288mm tail) [6] 106. Sidecut 151cm: 7.0m [MERCHANT][6] 107. Sidecut 161cm: 8.0m [6] 108. Sidecut 170W: 8.9m [6] 109. Reference stance 151cm: 500mm / 19.7" [6] 110. Reference stance 156cm: 540mm / 21.3" [6]. Comment: Merchant listing shows 580mm for 156cm — this is a discrepancy; the Jones official site shows 540mm for 154cm, 540mm for 155W, 540mm for 156cm. 111. DISAGREEMENT — Reference stance values (merchant vs. official): The merchant listing shows reference stance 151cm=540mm, 154cm=560mm, 156cm=580mm. The official Jones 2026 site shows 151cm=500mm, 154cm=520mm, 156cm=540mm. Comment: The official Jones site is the authoritative source. The merchant data appears to have systematically higher values by 40mm. 112. Contact length 151cm: 106.4cm [6] 113. Tip length 151cm: 22.8cm [6] 114. Tail length 151cm: 21.8cm [6] 115. Surface area 151cm: 39.0 dm² [6] 116. Centered stance 151cm: 52cm / 20.5" [6] 117. Recommended weight 151cm: 49-73kg / 110-160 lbs [MERCHANT][6] 118. Recommended weight 170W: 77-100+ kg / 170-220+ lbs [6] 119. Ideal boot size 151cm: US 7-9 / EU 39.5-41.5 [6] 120. Big Horn Series threshold: US Men's 11.5+ should look for boards with minimum waist width 26.3cm [6] 121. Binding recommended size 151cm: S/M [6] 122. FASE recommended size 151cm: M [6] 123. Jones official site user rating: 4.9/5 (19 reviews) [6] 124. Board of the World rating (2025 model): 83.2/100 (4.12/5) [9] 125. Board of the World all-mountain sub-score: 4.03/5 [26] 126. Board of the World park ranking: 34th out of 36 boards reviewed in park category [9] 127. The Good Ride overall verdict: "Very recommendable ride" — reviewer didn't want to return the demo [23] 128. evo Field Tested verdict: "Reliable, fun, and adaptable snowboard" — top contender for single-board riders [27] POSITIVE EXPERIENCES: 129. Turn initiation: "Easiest and most enjoyable turning experience I have had on a mid-soft board" (The Good Ride Women's review) [25] 130. Pop & spin ability: Reviewer spinning 540s without trying hard at age 41 [9] 131. Base glide: "Jones boards are notorious for having great base glide, and the Rally Cat is no exception" [25] 132. Lightweight: "One of the lightest boards that I've gotten to ride for the 2025 season" [9] 133. Buttering: Nose presses and buttering felt "extremely simple" [24] 134. Value: "Excellent value for its price because it offers all of the primary tech features that make a Jones board rip" [9] 135. Versatility (evo): "From bowls and trees to groomers and parks, the Rally Cat handles it all" [27] 136. Switch riding: Easy switch riding; "rides switch really well" [25] 137. Flat basing: Tracked very well one-footing and flat-basing in all conditions [23] 138. Forgiving camber: Despite full camber, very easy to skid a turn; not as unforgiving as it looks [23] NEGATIVE EXPERIENCES / LIMITATIONS: 139. High-speed stability: Not the most stable at high speeds — "not for you if you like decent speed" [28] 140. Aggressive carving limitation: Not an "elbows-to-the-ground" board; can't put power or speed into traditional euro-carve [25] 141. Uneven snow: "Challenging on uneven snow and required a lot of on-the-fly adjustments" [25] 142. Base die-cut quality: "The base of the Jones Rally Cat had too much die-cut for my taste, and I could feel it when running my fingers over it" [28] 143. Board weight comparison: Feels "a little heavier than the Aviator 2.0" [23] 144. Not ideal for: Aggressive riders, racing, very steep/technical terrains [27] 145. Not ideal for: Deep powder (board not designed for it; Mind Expander recommended instead) [29] 146. Park ranking: Relatively low park ranking (34th/36) suggests better all-mountain boards exist for pure park riders [9] 147. Similar shape to: Jones Aviator 2.0 (with similar flex to the Jones Tweaker) [23] 148. Preferred over Jones Mountain Twin: The Good Ride reviewer liked the Rally Cat better than the Mountain Twin for all-mountain cruising [23] 149. Alternative for carving-focused riders: Jones Frontier — more stability for carving, faster base [9] 150. Alternative for aggressive freestyle: Jones Tweaker ($529.95) or Tweaker Pro ($629.95) [6] 151. Alternative all-mountain twin: Jones Mountain Twin ($579.95) [6] 152. Jones Frontier comparison: Frontier is more directional, stiffer, better in uneven snow; Rally Cat is more playful, better for buttering/pressing [28][30] 153. Rally Cat feels less washy than Mountain Twin Pro in hard snow turns [31] 154. Comparable women's boards: Capita Space Metal Fantasy, Jones Airheart, K2 Coldshoulder, Gnu Velvet [25] 155. The Good Ride 2025 Low-Cost Favorites list: Rally Cat made the list — "blew me away at this price point" [32] 156. Solar-powered production: Since 2020, manufacturing with 100% solar power, resulting in 89% drop in production CO₂ emissions [2] 157. Bio Resin CO₂ reduction: 33% less greenhouse gas emissions vs. conventional epoxy [6][12] 158. Recycled content: Recycled ABS sidewalls, recycled German steel edges [6] 159. Factory wax: WEND Natural Wax (biodegradable) [6] 160. 1% For The Planet: Jones donates 1% of sales to sustainability-focused non-profits [4] 161. Re-Up Tech: Jones offers a program to recycle old snowboards and upcycle materials; send in dead board, get $50 toward a new one [6] 162. Men's 2025 color: Orange [9] 163. Women's 2025 color: Pinkish purple [9] 164. Graphic style: Not specified in detail; described as having "vibrant graphics" in evo women's review [33]
